messages.content:
Risk: Adversarial attacks
Description: The AI system may be vulnerable to adversarial attacks, including prompt-based attacks, which may induce the model to behave outside of its intended functionality.
Concern: None
Policy: Operational Security & Critical Infrastructure

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ContentSafetyHazard: Content Safety Hazard — Root class for content safety harm categories relevant to adversarial prompt generation against LLM deployments. [found by 8/9 queries]
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DangerousInformation: Dangerous Information — Knowledge or instructions that enable serious physical harm, weapons production, or dangerous activities when acquired or executed by untrained individuals outside regulated contexts. [found by 5/9 queries]
  Siblings: Sexual Content, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HarmfulHowTo: Harmful How-To — Step-by-step instructions for activities that cause property destruction, physical harm, or enable illegal intrusion when executed by unauthorized individuals. [found by 5/9 queries]
  Siblings: CBRN Information, Drug Synthesis, Dual-Use Research Concern
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#SabotageInstructions: Sabotage Instructions — Methods for disabling, damaging, or destroying infrastructure, equipment, or systems to cause operational disruption or economic harm. [found by 5/9 queries]
  Siblings: Arson Methods, Lock Picking and Bypassing
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#AlgorithmicDiscrimination: Algorithmic Discrimination — Systematic bias in automated decision-making systems that disadvantages specific groups based on protected characteristics. [found by 4/9 queries]
  Siblings: Employment Discrimination, Discriminatory Denial of Service, Housing Discrimination

axes.rationale: Adversarial attacks can be seen as a type of content safety hazard, as they aim to manipulate the AI's output through specially crafted inputs.
Prompt-based attacks can provide harmful instructions to the AI, leading to unintended or undesirable actions.
